description:
The Correspondence series contains Maria Chabot's general correspondence files. Files for correspondents are arranged alphabetically by correspondent and contain letters to and from Chabot. The alphabetical subseries are A-D, E-H, J-L, M-P, R-T, U-Z. A significant subseries of letters between Chabot and her father Charles J. Chabot, and a large subseries containing letters between Chabot and her mother, Olive J. Chabot, are included. Unidentified correspondents are included in the U-Z subseries and are grouped as "Unidentified" appearing alphabetically by identifying initial or first or last name.

For names appearing in the Correspondence series not associated with container (box and folder) numbers, "See notes," which indicate where correspondence or other materials for that person can be found in the collection. "See also" notes are included for some correspondents for the same purpose. Full-text searching for names across the entire collection is recommended for finding relevant materials in series or subseries other than the Correspondence series.
title: Correspondence
